## Summary

Discovered while proving `abusive-pebbly-sakimonkey` (e339-9709-15fe-419a). Independent of
that ticket's FIT divergence: under `reconciler.rich_text_cutover = "cloud"` (this project's
setting, `rebar.toml:87`) the outbound comment differ decodes the two sides of its
body-equality key with DIFFERENT decoders, so a markdown comment WELL WITHIN the length limit
never matches its own landed body.

- **Local side** — `_diff_comments` computes `codec.normalize_outbound(...)`. In rich mode
  `AdfCodec.normalize_outbound` is a markdown round trip, which ESCAPES markdown-active
  characters and rewrites autolinks.
- **Jira side** — `_normalize_comment_body` calls `inbound_mapper.normalize_rich_text`
  (`inbound_fields.normalize_rich_text` -> `adf_to_text`), which does NOT escape.

## Runtime evidence

Driving the real `AdfCodec(rich=True)` and `_JiraInbound` on current main
(worktree `fix-sakimonkey-dedupkey`), with an in-limit markdown body:

```
local key : '# Head\n\nSome *bold* text and a [link](<http://x>) plus `code`.\n\n- a\n- b'
landed key: '# Head\n\nSome *bold* text and a [link](http://x) plus `code`.\n\n- a\n- b'
EQUAL?    : False
```

The same asymmetry escapes the truncation notice: the local key carries
`\[truncated by reconciler\]` where the landed body carries `[truncated by reconciler]`.

## Confirmed root cause (Phase 1, worktree fix-17c3)

Reproduced deterministically by capturing the real send path (`acli_cli_ops.add_comment`,
only `_run_acli` stubbed): the landed wire is `to_wire(fit_preserving_marker(DECORATED
body))`, and because the decoration `<!-- rebar:reconciler-echo -->` is an HTML comment,
`markdown_to_adf`'s documented content-preservation fallback (`adf.py`, `markdown_to_adf`)
degrades the WHOLE document to the plain `text_to_adf` encode. The Jira-side key decodes that
wire with `adf_to_text` (no escaping). The local key instead round-trips the UNDECORATED body
through `adf_to_markdown(markdown_to_adf(...))` (`outbound_comments.py`, `_diff_comments`
`compare_body`), which both escapes markdown-active characters AND renders rich — two
divergences from the landed form with one root cause: the two keys are produced by different
decode compositions.

## Fix plan (one decoder)

In `_diff_comments`, derive the LOCAL key by predicting the exact wire the send path produces
and decoding it with the SAME decoder already used on the fetched Jira side:
`_normalize_comment_body(codec.to_wire(_decorate_outbound_comment(sanitizer.fit_comment(body))))`
replacing `_normalize_comment_body(codec.normalize_outbound(sanitizer.fit_comment(body)))`.
`to_wire` is already part of the `RichTextCodec` Protocol; `_IdentityCodec` grows an identity
`to_wire` so the no-codec fallback is unchanged. Send-path behavior is NOT touched — this is
key derivation only. Verified at runtime across the 8-cell matrix (cutover off/cloud x
{in-limit md, over-length md, plain in-limit, oversize plain}): the new key equals the landed
key in every cell; the old key diverges in 3 cloud cells; every cell where the old key already
matched still matches (no loosening, no shifted in-limit plain key).

## Testing

- RED test first: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_comment_dedup_key_matches_send_fit.py`
  gains cases under `REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=cloud` with an in-limit markdown body:
  the landed side CAPTURED from the real `add_comment` (only `_run_acli` stubbed, same pattern
  as the existing tests in that file), asserting `_diff_comments` emits no duplicate mutation
  (RED pre-fix) and that a genuinely new markdown comment is still emitted (counter-regression).
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/ tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_dc_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_codec.py -q`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`
- `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` (no new/increased entries)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The differ's two comparison keys are produced by the same decode under every
      `rich_text_cutover` setting — verified by `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_comment_dedup_key_matches_send_fit.py -q`.
- [x] A test drives an in-limit markdown comment through the differ with the cutover ON and
      asserts no duplicate mutation is emitted (RED on current code) — checked: run the new
      test at the pre-fix commit and observe the failure, then GREEN post-fix.
